title: Verify test.gokesari.com is reachable, renders without 500s and runs the build under test
description: Guest and admin open the home page and database-backed pages; no 500, hydration error or 404 from an older build or a missing migration.

title: Verify staging is configured for testing: business-rule defaults, SMTP sign-in codes and running crons
description: Admin checks the nine rule groups in /admin/settings, the guest sign-in form for SMTP, and the dispatch cron counter before any run starts.

title: Verify every test account signs in to the right portal and the seed data the suite needs is present
description: Admin, operator, shop owners, customers, an approved rider and a society admin sign in; missing shops, products or riders are created first.

title: Verify the 3-Oct requirements and the open features treated as completed are deployed on test
description: Shop owner and admin record whether NEW-008/009/010 and the listed open features are live; missing ones mark their cases Blocked, not Fail.

title: Verify gokesari.com is touched only by read-only smoke checks during a test run
description: No order, payment, suspension, setting or registration is made on production; guest pages load without errors and no form is submitted.

title: Verify a new or returning user can sign in with a one-time code emailed to the account's address
description: Guest signs up with an unused mobile or email only, or signs back in with a registered mobile; the code goes to the masked email and home opens.

title: Verify first-time onboarding captures details and a geo-tagged address, and can be skipped until checkout
description: Customer fills details and a geo-tagged address or skips; the add-mobile prompt repeats until set, and the cart asks for mobile and address before pay.

title: Verify Google sign-in and the email magic link still work and the session persists across pages
description: Guest signs in through Google or a single-use magic link; the wallet exists and the customer stays signed in across pages and reloads.

title: Verify the sign-in code can be sent by SMS, with email offered when the SMS cannot be sent
description: Guest picks SMS or email on the channel step; new and returning mobiles receive the SMS code; a provider failure is reported and email is offered.

title: Verify a customer can edit name and gender and change mobile or email only with a code sent to the new one
description: Customer edits My Profile; a mobile change needs an SMS code to the new number and an email change a code to the new address, with security notices.

title: Verify sign out ends the session on the server for every role and closes all protected pages
description: All roles sign out from the header (also on a phone); old cookies get 401, Back shows no cached data, cross-site log out fails and events are audited.

title: Verify log out across tabs, devices, roles and a shared phone never leaks one user's data to the next
description: Customer, shop owner and rider log out in other tabs, devices, mid-edit, while online or in a second role; carts stay per user; session lifetime holds.

title: Verify wrong, expired, superseded and replayed sign-in codes are refused and five failures lock the code
description: Guest enters bad email or SMS codes; each gets the generic wrong/expired message, older and used codes fail, and after five tries a new code is needed.

title: Verify the 60-second resend cooldown and the hourly and per-IP code limits, as set in /admin/settings
description: Guest requests email and SMS codes past the cooldown, hourly and IP limits and is refused (429 with retry time); admin changes the OTP limits.

title: Verify invalid mobiles and emails are rejected and sign-in never reveals whether another person has an account
description: Guest enters malformed or non-Indian numbers and bad emails; no code or SMS is sent, and registered vs unregistered identifiers look the same.

title: Verify a mobile number or email can belong to only one account unless an admin releases it
description: Customer is refused a mobile or email already on another account or without its SMS code; admin releases a claimed mobile with an audit row.

title: Verify suspended accounts cannot sign in and sign-in codes are audited but never exposed
description: Guest with a suspended account is refused with a grievance link; admin sees masked OTP/SMS audit rows and no code in any response, page or log.

title: Verify a guest can browse and search shops but is sent to sign-in for every signed-in page and API
description: Guest reads home, shops and products freely; add to cart prompts sign-in and every signed-in page redirects while APIs return 401.

title: Verify a user holding several roles can switch between them but never into a role not held
description: Shop owner who is also a customer switches portal and navigation; a customer's switch to an unheld role gets 403/422 and stays unchanged.

title: Verify every role can place a personal order and only shop owners place B2B orders from other shops
description: Shop owner places personal and B2B orders; a customer, another owner's shop or own-shop items are refused for B2B with nothing debited.

title: Verify admin role changes are confirmed, audited and notified, and staff roles replace rather than stack
description: Admin grants roles with Save confirmation and audit; the user is notified; staff roles replace each other; pre-migration users keep their grants.

title: Verify revoking a user's active role or suspending the user takes effect on the next request
description: Admin revokes an operator's role (user falls back to CUSTOMER) or suspends a customer, who is signed out and cannot sign in again.

title: Verify customers and shop owners cannot open shop, rider, society, operator or admin portals they do not hold
description: Customer and shop owner are redirected from other roles' pages and get 403 FORBIDDEN from their APIs.

title: Verify an operator can verify shops but is kept out of admin settings, finance approvals and role changes
description: Operator verifies a shop; /admin/settings, finance approve/pay, suspensions and role changes are refused; limited shop edits are recorded.

title: Verify shop owners, riders and customers can read or change only their own shop, jobs and records
description: Shop owner calls against shop B, rider against other riders' jobs, and customer against customer 2's resources all get 403/404 with no change.

title: Verify order and settlement visibility is scoped to each role, with no customer PII shown to societies
description: Customer, shop, rider, society, operator and admin each see only their orders and statements; operator sees exceptions only; customer is refused.

title: Verify the audit log is full for admins, limited for operators, closed to others and append-only
description: Admin sees actor, role and old/new values; operator a subset; customer and shop are refused; database triggers block edits and deletes.

title: Verify a customer can set the 'Deliver to' location by PIN, device position or Places search, and clear it
description: Guest or customer sets the location by PIN, GPS (allow/deny) or Places; the gk_location cookie persists; an invalid PIN is refused with 422.

title: Verify discovery and the cart follow the signed-in customer's default or chosen saved address
description: Customer's default address drives discovery; choosing another saved address changes the delivering shops and preselects it in the cart.

title: Verify the address book can add, edit, re-pin, set default and delete addresses with a valid recipient mobile
description: Customer manages addresses; fields and the geo-tag persist, the default flag moves, deleted addresses leave the cart, and bad mobiles are refused.

title: Verify a customer can link an address only to a society they belong to
description: Customer links an address to their society and the order shows on the society dashboard; linking to a society they are not in is refused.

title: Verify a shop can set its delivery radius within limits and add extra delivery PIN zones
description: Shop owner saves radius values (audited) and out-of-range ones get 422; an extra PIN zone makes the shop deliverable there.

title: Verify only approved, delivering shops within their radius or matching PIN are listed as delivering
description: Customer at, inside and outside the radius sees the right shops; PIN-only shops match exactly; off, pending or suspended shops are never listed.

title: Verify the cart and checkout refuse items from a shop that does not deliver to the chosen address
description: Customer's cart flags only the non-delivering shop and re-checks when the address changes; the checkout API refuses with no order or debit.

title: Verify the shop's minimum order value and a paused shop block checkout until resolved
description: Customer below the Rs 200 minimum is asked to add items (pickup exempt); a shop owner's pause hides the shop and checkout refuses until un-paused.

title: Verify ordering from a closed shop needs confirmation, alerts are sent once and opening hours use IST
description: Customer confirms a closed-shop order (409 without it); shop and customer get one alert each; closed days and midnight are judged in IST.

title: Verify road-distance ETAs and rider navigation, with a straight-line fallback and one serviceability rule
description: Customer and rider see the same routed ETA; rider gets in-app route; a routing outage falls back to an approximate estimate; list, cart, checkout agree.

title: Verify the home page shows the location bar, delivering shops and local price-comparison widgets
description: Guest and customer see product-search hero, shop shelves and lowest-price widgets matching product pages, with empty states when nothing applies.

title: Verify the shop list shows only delivering shops nearest first, with search, filters and 'Show all shops'
description: Customer and guest search shops by name, category, area and PIN, filter by type, classification and delivery, and toggle all shops keeping filters.

title: Verify shop pages and category and department pages show the right profile, catalogue, hours and links
description: Guest opens a shop page with catalogue, rating, opening hours, closed-now state and delivery options, and browses category and department pages.

title: Verify product search lists only serviceable offers nearest first and handles odd input safely
description: Customer's product search shows in-zone offers with distance and 'Compare prices'; empty, long or script input shows an escaped empty state.

title: Verify the product page compares every local shop's price with lowest-price badge and per-unit prices
description: Customer sees all selling shops sorted deliverable+buyable, then price, then distance; per-unit price shown; out-of-stock rows marked, not buyable.

title: Verify product pages handle a bad id, a missing image and an in-shop-only product without errors
description: Guest gets a 404 for a bad product id and a neutral image placeholder; customer sees offline-only products marked 'In-shop only' with no Add to cart.

title: Verify external reference prices are shown apart from MRP and shop price and hidden when off or untrusted
description: Customer sees source, price and time of verified references; admin turning the rule off hides them; stale or rejected ones never show or change prices.

title: Verify a shop page lists only that shop's active offers with terms and expiry
description: Customer sees active offers that then apply at checkout; expired, paused and other shops' offers are not shown and no empty box appears.

title: Verify a customer can add, change and remove cart lines grouped per shop with each shop's delivery fee
description: Customer adds items from one or two shops; lines group by shop with subtotal and delivery fee; totals recompute; an empty cart shows an empty state.

title: Verify wallet checkout creates one confirmed order per shop and debits the wallet by exactly the total
description: Customer pays a single-shop or multi-shop cart from the wallet; each shop gets a CONFIRMED order and debit, stock falls, the cart empties, shops are told.

title: Verify order notes, delivery instructions and the order summary are carried through after checkout
description: Customer's notes reach the shop and landmark reaches the rider only after pickup; the order card shows number, shop, items, amount, status, actions.

title: Verify checkout needs a mobile and a delivery address, and a pickup order needs no address or rider
description: Customer without mobile or address sees prompts instead of pay and the API refuses; a pickup order has no delivery fee and the shop completes it.

title: Verify delivery windows and scheduled slots are feasible, limited by capacity and freed on cancellation
description: Customer sees only windows the system can meet; picks a real slot that shop and rider see; full or invalid slots are refused; cancelling frees it.

title: Verify a master order links the per-shop orders, handles one shop failing and is visible only to its shops
description: Customer gets one master reference with per-shop status; a failed or rejected shop is refunded alone; shop A sees only its child order.

title: Verify an order coupon applies before payment, is validated and capped, and refunds stay proportional
description: Customer applies one coupon per order; invalid coupons get a reason; total never below zero; cancel restores the use; settlement shows who pays.

title: Verify the cart enforces stock and valid quantities and shows live prices and lines that became unavailable
description: Customer cannot exceed stock or enter bad quantities; a shop's price change shows live and is charged as recomputed; unavailable lines block pay.

title: Verify checkout never double-charges: short balance, replays, stock races and the rate limit are handled
description: Customer with too little balance gets 402 and no order; a replayed or racing checkout yields one order set and debit; the 16th request gets 429.

title: Verify the wallet page and a Cashfree sandbox top-up that credits exactly the amount within Rs 1-1,00,000
description: Customer sees balance, forecast and transactions and tops up; out-of-range amounts get 422; failed or abandoned top-ups credit nothing and can retry.

title: Verify the low-balance threshold, auto-recharge settings and the one-time subscription low-balance warning
description: Customer saves a threshold and auto-recharge (both values needed) and gets one low-balance warning with the subscription forecast.

title: Verify top-up voucher bonuses, their rules, admin voucher management and promotional balance on refunds
description: Customer gets a voucher bonus as promotional balance or a specific refusal; admin creates, pauses and bulk-uploads vouchers; refunds split correctly.

title: Verify an order can be paid by wallet, COD or online by UPI, card or netbanking, including a multi-shop cart
description: Customer sees no dead payment option; online payment confirms the order with method ONLINE; a multi-shop cart is paid once with one order per shop.

title: Verify full and partial refunds of an online order go back to the original payment method exactly once
description: Customer gets refunds to source with reference and timing; operator over-refunds and replays are refused; a gateway failure becomes a finance exception.

title: Verify online payment states, illegal transitions, chargebacks and reconciliation mismatches
description: Admin sees CREATED to RECONCILED with time stamps, illegal moves refused, a chargeback holding the shop settlement, and mismatches as exceptions.

title: Verify declined, abandoned, over-limit or unplaceable online payments never confirm an order or charge
description: Customer's declined or abandoned payment releases stock and keeps the cart; over-limit amounts and unplaceable orders stop before the gateway opens.

title: Verify wallet top-ups cannot be forged, replayed or rate-abused and the balance never goes negative
description: Customer's forged or replayed verify credits nothing; a bad webhook signature is rejected; the 11th payment call gets 429; the dev top-up is closed.

title: Verify an order is confirmed only by a verified gateway payment and no card or UPI details are stored
description: Forged or altered payments are refused; webhooks with bad signatures fail and duplicates change nothing; two-tab double pay is blocked or refunded.

title: Verify a shop can opt in to COD and an eligible customer's COD order is confirmed unpaid exactly once
description: Shop owner turns COD on; customer's COD order is CONFIRMED with no wallet debit and stock reduced; a replayed checkout returns the same order.

title: Verify a COD delivery completes only when cash collection is confirmed by the rider, an operator or the shop
description: Rider must confirm cash to mark DELIVERED (recorded against the rider); operator override needs cashCollected; shop self-delivery holds cash as SHOP.

title: Verify cash deposits reduce held COD cash and remaining held cash is netted in the next payout
description: Admin records deposits (no over-deposit, no double count on replay); net payout is earnings minus cash held, and negative batches are flagged.

title: Verify cancelling a COD order refunds nothing and refunding a delivered COD order credits the wallet
description: Customer cancels before delivery with stock restored and no refund; operator refunds a delivered COD order as a wallet credit with cash as payment.

title: Verify COD is refused for ineligible orders and paused after failed COD deliveries or a HIGH risk flag
description: Customer's COD for B2B, no address, a shop not opted in, over Rs 2,000 or a 3rd open COD order is refused with the reason; exactly Rs 2,000 is allowed.

title: Verify an order moves through every status in order with history, and illegal transitions are refused
description: All roles see CONFIRMED to DELIVERED with time stamps, labels, history and audit rows; a shop's skipped or backward move gets 409 and nothing changes.

title: Verify guarded transitions: no manual confirm of unpaid orders, DISPUTED ops-only, RETURNED only after failure
description: Shop cannot confirm an unpaid order or set DISPUTED (operator can; disputed orders skip settlement); RETURNED is allowed only after a failed delivery.

title: Verify a customer can cancel a CONFIRMED order for a full refund but not once the shop has started on it
description: Customer cancels CONFIRMED for a full wallet refund; ACCEPTED to ASSIGNED is blocked; after pickup only goods are refunded; final states go to support.

title: Verify a shop or operator can cancel at any stage with a full refund of what is still held
description: Shop owner and operator cancel at each status; the full remaining amount is refunded once, rider paid only after pickup, removed lines not restocked.

title: Verify cancellation restores stock, refunds exactly once and keeps the order out of every settlement
description: Shop owner sees stock back with an inventory movement; a repeated refund call pays once; admin finds cancelled orders in no settlement batch.

title: Verify an order the shop does not accept in time is auto-cancelled once with a refund by payment method
description: System cancels at the admin-set timeout (not while closed, timed from opening) with wallet, source or no refund by method; both sides notified once.

title: Verify a shop is alerted to a new order, sees it in the right tab and can accept it or reject it with a reason
description: Shop owner gets in-app and email alerts; each order sits in one status tab; accept notifies the customer; reject needs a reason and refunds in full.

title: Verify a shop picks lines and marks the order READY, starting the rider search, and cannot advance held orders
description: Shop owner picks lines to PREPARING and READY (rider search starts), sees the pickup code but never the delivery OTP; subscription orders stay one-click.

title: Verify a customer approves or rejects a shop's substitute and never pays more than the original line
description: Shop owner proposes a substitute that blocks READY; customer approval refunds any cheaper difference at once; rejection removes and refunds the line.

title: Verify removing a line refunds it immediately and removing every line cancels the order
description: Shop owner removes a line and the customer is refunded and notified; removing the last line cancels the order and refunds the delivery fee too.

title: Verify invalid substitutes are refused and only the ordering customer can decide a substitution
description: Shop owner's invalid substitute proposals are refused; another customer or user deciding the substitution gets 403/404.

title: Verify marking an order READY automatically offers it to online, approved riders only
description: Rider gets an offer within seconds without the shop pressing anything; offline, suspended or unapproved riders are never offered.

title: Verify rider ranking prefers nearer, free and reliable riders and spreads offers fairly
description: Riders are ranked by distance, busy status (lower, not excluded), reliability and today's offer count so the right rider is offered first.

title: Verify society rider lists: exclusive lists offer only listed riders and non-exclusive lists offer them first
description: Society admin's listed and preferred riders are offered in order; exclusive societies never fall back; empty lists never block; revoking applies at once.

title: Verify two nearby orders can be batched to one rider within limits, revealing only the current drop
description: Rider gets one trip with separate pickup codes, OTPs and earnings per order; no batch over the limit or far apart; next drop's details stay hidden.

title: Verify admin dispatch rule changes apply to new searches and operators can assign or reassign before pickup
description: Admin edits dispatch rules for the next search; operator assigns and reassigns riders (ASSIGNED to READY to new offer); reassign after pickup is blocked.

title: Verify the rider search is bounded and can be restarted, stopped or ended by cancelling the order
description: Shop owner sees 'Looking for a rider - attempt N of 10' every 60 s, one notice at the limit, a manual cooldown, restart and stop; cancel ends it.

title: Verify an offer expires after 2 minutes, a decliner is not re-offered and no rider is double-booked
description: Rider offers lapse after about 120 s to the next rider; a rider who declined never sees the order again; concurrent orders never share one rider.

title: Verify the assign API and the cron endpoints refuse shops, customers and callers without the cron token
description: Shop owner and customer calls to the assign API get 403; guest calls to the dispatch, notification, risk, finance and daily-order crons get 403.

title: Verify a rider applies, passes operations KYC review, and only APPROVED, unblocked partners can go online
description: Checks the rider application, operator review (approve, reject, suspend, block) and the partner state rules that decide who may take jobs; roles: rider applicant, operator.

title: Verify an online rider receives offers for READY orders and can accept only within the offer window
description: Checks offer acceptance within 2 minutes, refusal of expired or cancelled offers, and that no offers reach a rider who is offline; role: rider.

title: Verify the rider collects the order with the shop's pickup code and only then sees the customer's drop details
description: Checks arrival at the shop, the pickup code check, Start delivery revealing the full address, arrival at the customer and Google Maps links; roles: rider, shop, customer.

title: Verify the rider hands over only after the customer's delivery OTP matches, with a lock after five wrong tries
description: Checks OTP delivery (earning, notifications, finance snapshot), the 5-try lock and the operator override that needs a proof note; roles: rider, customer, operator.

title: Verify photo proof of delivery is saved, validated and visible only to the customer and operations
description: Checks the handover photo with its time, refusal of missing, oversized or disguised files, and that other users cannot open the photo; roles: rider, customer, operator.

title: Verify failed deliveries, shop self-delivery and a suspended rider's active job are closed out correctly
description: Checks the 'customer not reachable' failure with return and refund, legacy shop self-delivery while no rider is active, and reassignment of a suspended rider's job; roles: rider, shop, operator.

title: Verify a rider sees the right gig portal pages and edits vehicle and bank details without touching KYC status
description: Checks gig portal views per rider state, hidden identity and bank data, code-confirmed bank changes, field validation and that a rider cannot self-approve or edit another rider.

title: Verify riders never receive codes or customer identity and order tracking is limited to the order's parties
description: Checks that rider pages and APIs carry no pickup code, OTP or customer contact, that tracking is allowed only for customer, shop, assigned rider and operator, and the live map gap.

title: Verify a resident registers a society that operators can verify, reject, suspend or reinstate
description: Checks society registration as APPLIED, refusal of a duplicate name and PIN, the operator status changes with audit, and order dispatch for a suspended society; roles: customer, operator.

title: Verify residents join only verified societies and the society admin manages roles, keeping the last admin
description: Checks join requests with unit labels, approval or decline, refusal for unverified societies, role changes by ADMIN only, last-admin protection and leaving a society; roles: resident, society admin.

title: Verify the society dashboard lists rules, residents, riders and partner shops, and partner shops rank first
description: Checks the /society/{id} dashboard sections and that a partner shop added by the society admin appears first and serviceable for residents; roles: society admin, resident.

title: Verify a society order is offered only to its authorised riders, managed by mobile number by the society admin
description: Checks adding, preferring and revoking authorised riders with audit, and the end-to-end society order from checkout to OTP delivery; roles: society admin, resident, shop, rider.

title: Verify the rider sees the society's gate rules and security is notified on acceptance only when opted in
description: Checks gate notes, entry mode and the security-desk number shown to the rider on the active job only, and the opt-in security notification; roles: society admin, rider.

title: Verify society staff see no resident personal data and cannot act on other societies
description: Checks that the deliveries list and society API carry no resident contact or order contents, and that residents and cross-society staff get 403 while platform operators are allowed.

title: Verify a customer sets up a daily or weekly milk subscription with a correct cost preview
description: Checks the 2 L/day preview (Rs 140 per delivery, Rs 980 a week), weekday-only weekly schedules and that a draft creates no order until activated; role: customer.

title: Verify the daily job creates and charges exactly one order per due day, which is then delivered normally
description: Checks one CONFIRMED order and one wallet debit per day on re-runs, fulfilment and rider delivery, the closed-shop exception and ORDER_CREATED / FULFILLED history; roles: system, shop, rider.

title: Verify a customer can change tomorrow's quantity, skip a date and pause or resume a subscription
description: Checks a one-day quantity override that reverts the next day, a skipped date with no order or charge, and the inclusive pause window with resume; role: customer.

title: Verify a subscription can be cancelled or renewed at its end date, with every event kept in its history
description: Checks cancellation with a reason, RENEWAL_PENDING then ACTIVE or COMPLETED at the end date, and the history rows for each action; role: customer.

title: Verify a subscription day with low wallet balance or an unavailable shop makes no order and tells the customer
description: Checks the failed day for insufficient balance with a single debit on retry after top-up, and the 'unavailable' outcome when the shop cannot deliver; roles: customer, system.

title: Verify final states, past dates and other users' subscriptions cannot be changed
description: Checks that cancelled or completed subscriptions, past or processed dates and illegal DRAFT or COMPLETED moves are refused, and that only the owner can open a subscription.

title: Verify a customer raises a return within the window, with photos for damage and no more than was delivered
description: Checks the return form, the photo rule for 'Damaged', quantity and duplicate guards and refusal after the return window; role: customer.

title: Verify the shop reviews the return evidence and approves or rejects it, with the photos kept private
description: Checks shop approval (rider pickup offered), rejection with a reason shown to the customer, the no-delivery shop handover path and evidence photo privacy; roles: shop, customer.

title: Verify a rider collects a return only with the customer's handover code and is paid the pickup fee
description: Checks pickup acceptance and scheduling, the handover code with its 5-try lock, the flat rider fee and the 'could not collect' path; roles: rider, customer, shop.

title: Verify the shop inspects returned goods and the refund reaches the wallet exactly once
description: Checks full and partial refunds after inspection with the shop's share in the ledger, rejection at inspection and an exactly-once refund retry; roles: shop, operator.

title: Verify a customer follows a return's status and can cancel it only before the rider sets off
description: Checks the /returns timeline at each step and cancellation before set-off, with support needed after; role: customer.

title: Verify only operations refund a delivered order, in full or part, never beyond what remains
description: Checks operator refunds charged to SHOP or PLATFORM with shop-share maths, refusal of over-refunds and replays, and 403 for shop owners and customers.

title: Verify operations resolve disputed orders, work the returns queue and change the returns rules
description: Checks that a DISPUTED order is held out of settlement until resolved, the admin returns queue actions and new return rules from admin settings; roles: operator, admin.

title: Verify a customer reports a problem on their own order or contacts the shop without leaking data
description: Checks ticket creation linked to the order, field validation, refusal on another customer's order and the shop contact page; role: customer.

title: Verify a grievance is raised publicly and moved by operations through each status to closure
description: Checks the /grievance form and reference lookup, and the OPEN to CLOSED ladder with who and when, SLA counters and customer notices; roles: guest, customer, operator.

title: Verify grievances escalate when a resolution is rejected or late, and illegal moves are refused
description: Checks ESCALATED tickets reaching the senior queue, refusal of skipped or backward transitions, and 403 when a customer sets a staff-only state; roles: customer, operator.

title: Verify a customer rates the shop and rider once per delivered order within 30 days
description: Checks the public anonymous shop review and average, the private rider rating, no rider rating for shop self-delivery, and refusal of ineligible or out-of-range ratings.

title: Verify only moderators can hide and restore ratings, which updates the public list and average
description: Checks hiding a rating with a reason and restoring it in /admin/ratings, and 403 when a shop owner tries the same; roles: operator, shop.

title: Verify a shop registers once as PENDING_APPROVAL, directly, with a referral code or through an operator
description: Checks shop registration with a registration number and SHOP_OWNER role, single submit on double-click, kept form values, referral attribution and operator-on-behalf; roles: customer, operator.

title: Verify an operator approves a shop with a classification or rejects it, and a rejected shop can resubmit
description: Checks approval with KESARI or GREEN classification, rejection with a reason, resubmission on the same record and that classification changes need a reason and are staff-only.

title: Verify the registration fee is snapshotted, paid in full before approval and visible only to its own shop
description: Checks the fee schedule snapshot, part and full payments with reversal only, approval blocked until the fee is paid, and owners seeing only their own payment history; roles: admin, operator, shop.

title: Verify GSTIN and PAN are submitted, verified by operations and kept masked except for audited reveal
description: Checks GST verify or reject, PAN masking with a permission-gated, audited reveal, and the seller compliance fields (legal name, FSSAI, return policy); roles: shop, operator.

title: Verify the shop's KYC documents are uploaded, validated by content, reviewed and kept private
description: Checks GST, PAN, FSSAI and Shop Act uploads with one KYC status, mandatory-document and bad-file refusal, reject and re-upload, and 403/404 for anyone else; roles: shop, operator.

title: Verify a shop moves from KYC_PENDING to ACTIVE in order and only an ACTIVE shop can sell
description: Checks the KYC, payment, verification and approval states, owner closure of a shop, refusal of illegal state jumps and that non-ACTIVE shops are not listed or orderable.

title: Verify shop categories and the shop profile are managed by the right roles
description: Checks admin category management (General cannot be deleted), operator category assignment, owner and cross-shop category permissions and shop profile settings; roles: admin, operator, shop.

title: Verify an admin previews and applies a shop suspension, the owner is told, and customers cannot buy
description: Checks the impact preview, order handling on suspension (cancel and refund, continue, hold), the owner's banner and email, blocked checkout and concurrent suspend safety.

title: Verify held orders are decided, the shop is reinstated, and the suspension policy is applied everywhere
description: Checks 'let the shop finish' and 'cancel and refund' on held orders, reinstatement, the configurable suspension policy and suspension from the risk page; roles: admin, operator.

title: Verify registration needs a category and at least one valid business identifier in the right format
description: Checks refusal without Shop Act, PAN (with holder name) or Udyam, format checks with normalisation, the category rule and malformed GSTIN or PAN; roles: customer, shop.

title: Verify the same shop cannot be registered twice by Shop Act, PAN or Udyam, while real branches are allowed
description: Checks masked duplicate messages, the PAN/Udyam same-place rule, the owner's own pending shop, the rate-limited on-blur pre-check and approval blocked by a licence now held by another.

title: Verify products enter the master catalogue, shop-created ones need approval, and shops list them
description: Checks master product creation with a system code, shop-created products seen only by their shop until approved, mapping to a shop listing and escaped specifications; roles: operator, shop.

title: Verify owner price changes apply at once by form or Excel, while operator changes wait for owner approval
description: Checks immediate logged owner changes, operator changes pending owner approval, Excel validate-preview-apply, row-level Excel errors, channel price rules and 403 for customers.

title: Verify a selling price never exceeds the verified MRP and the discount shown is correct
description: Checks admin MRP with source and audit, price above MRP refused by form, API and Excel, discount display, lowering MRP below a price, MRP claims and price references; roles: admin, shop, customer.

title: Verify a shop can set its own MRP for a product without changing other shops or the master
description: Checks the shop-specific MRP, other shops following the master, per-shop discounts, history, Excel MRP changes, falling back to the master and past orders unchanged; roles: shop, admin, customer.

title: Verify a loose product carries no default price until the shop owner sets one
description: Checks an empty (null, not 0) price in the master and on the shop listing, owner pricing per kg, field validation, blank loose rows in Excel and existing shop prices kept; roles: operator, shop.

title: Verify customers never see or buy an unpriced loose product at Rs 0
description: Checks the 'price not set' label with no Add button, compare-prices ordering, a cart line whose price was cleared, and cart or checkout refusal through the API; role: customer.

title: Verify shop stock updates, never goes negative and raises one low-stock alert per crossing
description: Checks stock edits with inventory movements, reservation on order, the listing-product-shop threshold order, a single alert per crossing and reorder levels; role: shop.

title: Verify adding a category lists every active master product at stock 100 with catalogue or empty prices
description: Checks one listing per product at on-hand 100, catalogue prices capped at MRP, empty prices for loose or unpriced items, storefront display, no false alerts and stock correction; role: shop.

title: Verify the category auto-add rules for operator adds, registration categories, later products and removal
description: Records the behaviour still to be confirmed with the owner: operator-added categories, the registration category, later master products and removing a category with stock or open orders.

title: Verify product photos are managed by the owning shop, validated by content and shown only after moderation
description: Checks add, primary, reorder, replace and delete, upload refusal by content, the rate limit, moderation approve or reject, and 403 for other shops and non-moderators; roles: shop, operator.

title: Verify the shop MRP is validated, caps the same shop's selling price and cannot be changed for other shops
description: Checks MRP field validation, the selling price checked against the shop's own MRP, and 403/404 when an owner targets another shop's listing or the admin MRP API; role: shop.

title: Verify a category add never duplicates, overwrites or leaks listings, whatever the category size
description: Checks existing listings left untouched, no duplicates on double-click or repeat, shared products, inactive products excluded, empty and large categories and other shops unaffected.

title: Verify staff can browse and search the Product Master while its APIs stay closed to customers and guests
description: Checks the dashboard (sources, data quality, review queue), product search with identity fields, offers and price history, and 401/403 for customers and guests; role: admin.

title: Verify supplier feeds are validated before import, duplicates are merged, and products are promoted to shops
description: Checks validate-then-import with row errors and source recording, merge-or-keep decisions in the duplicate queue and promotion into the catalogue linked to the master; role: admin.

title: Verify customers, shops and riders get an in-app notification for each order step
description: Checks in-app notices for placed, accepted, rider assigned, picked up, arriving, delivered and cancelled, the shop and rider notices, and the unread count; roles: customer, shop, rider.

title: Verify order events also reach the customer by email, SMS, WhatsApp and push
description: Checks email for each order step, SMS with the order number, WhatsApp from the approved sender and templates, and a push that opens the right order; role: customer.

title: Verify a customer's per-category, per-channel notification settings are saved and respected
description: Checks the email switch per category, SMS, push and WhatsApp choices, nothing sent on a switched-off channel, and denied or expired push permission handled quietly; role: customer.

title: Verify account and security notices always go out and cannot be switched off
description: Checks that the security category is locked in the UI and API, and that number links, role changes and suspensions always notify; role: customer.

title: Verify the same event sends one message per channel and long or Hindi text arrives readable
description: Checks de-duplication of repeated events such as low balance, and long shop names and Hindi or Marathi text delivered without cuts or garbling; role: customer.

title: Verify failed sends are retried, dead-lettered and shown to admins, and never marked sent
description: Checks the FAILED, retry and DEAD path with admin requeue, emails SKIPPED when no SMTP is set, and other channels still delivering when a provider fails; role: admin.

title: Verify notifications stay private and no promotional SMS or WhatsApp is sent without consent
description: Checks 403/404 on another user's notification and that campaigns reach only consenting customers, with STOP withdrawing consent; role: customer.

title: Verify commission is taken at the shop, shop-type or default rate in force at delivery
description: Checks setting commission rates with audit, the shop > shop type > default order, the rate snapshot per order and refusal of invalid values or operator edits; role: admin.

title: Verify every delivered order gets exactly one finance snapshot with correct goods, GMV and shop payable
description: Checks snapshot maths after removed or substituted lines, one snapshot on each delivery path and the full order money trace; role: admin.

title: Verify weekly shop settlements are prepared once, move through approval to payment, and match the shop view
description: Checks Monday-only batches with holds and exclusions, no duplicates on re-run, the PENDING to PAID life cycle with UTR, failure, reversal and cancel, and the shop finance page; roles: admin, shop.

title: Verify a rider's earning uses the base and per-km rate of the matching time slot
description: Checks the default Rs 20 + Rs 8 per km earning, time-slot rates, overnight and overlapping slot priority, and that switching a slot off leaves past earnings unchanged; roles: rider, admin.

title: Verify rider incentives, the minimum earning top-up and failed or cancelled delivery payouts
description: Checks incentives paid once when earned, the Rs 60 minimum top-up and the failed-delivery and cancel-after-pickup payout rules; role: admin.

title: Verify riders see their own earnings and are paid weekly net of adjustments and COD cash held
description: Checks the rider earnings and payouts view, weekly payout batches (prepare, approve, pay, cancel) and manual SHOP or RIDER adjustments counted once; roles: rider, admin.

title: Verify reconciliation matches orders, payments, settlements and payouts and its exceptions are resolved
description: Checks MATCHED records and named exceptions, resolution with a note and operator limits, the finance exceptions queue, the period summary in IST and a retried subscription payment.

title: Verify GST tax invoices, bills of supply and credit notes are issued correctly after delivery
description: Checks the shop and platform invoices, a bill of supply for a shop without GSTIN, a credit note after a refund, per-line GST to the paisa and gap-free numbering; role: customer.

title: Verify finance data and invoices are closed to roles that should not see or move money
description: Checks 403 for operators approving or paying settlements, for shop, rider and customer on finance APIs, and for other customers or shops opening an invoice.

title: Verify the admin control tower and the shop dashboard show live figures that match the order screens
description: Checks the /admin/dashboard sections, figures moving exactly with order actions and matching orders and analytics, and the /shop dashboard counts; roles: admin, shop.

title: Verify operators can find any order and see stuck orders in the exceptions queue with working actions
description: Checks the exceptions categories and per-row actions, order filters by status, shop and date with invalid values ignored, and one row per order; role: operator.

title: Verify only admins change business rules, within allowed ranges, with each change audited
description: Checks that operators get 403 on /admin/settings, out-of-range values such as OTP length 2 are refused, and save or restore applies quickly with before/after audit; role: admin.

title: Verify admins edit and reinstate users but can never suspend an admin account
description: Checks profile edits with Save confirmation and audit, reinstatement of a suspended user (409, 404, 403 cases), and 403 for suspending admins or yourself; role: admin.

title: Verify risk rules raise one flag per subject and large orders are flagged at the right thresholds
description: Checks the /admin/risk queue with combined filters, one refreshed flag on re-run, and the 5x and Rs 10,000 large-order thresholds; roles: operator, admin.

title: Verify risk flags are dismissed, actioned or turned into a suspension only with a reason by the right role
description: Checks dismiss and action with a required note, suspend-from-flag with a 5-character reason, and operators offered suspend for shops and riders only; roles: operator, admin.

title: Verify the operator landing, compliance, Maps usage and consent panels load in the console
description: Checks /operator reaches onboarding, product uploads, payments and exceptions, the compliance and Maps usage panels, and records what the consent view shows; roles: operator, admin.

title: Verify customers can grant and withdraw marketing consent and T&C consent is recorded at sign-up
description: Customer consent changes are saved with history, sign-up records T&C consent, and a withdrawn customer drops out of shop audiences.

title: Verify a shop owner sees the marketing page and builds consent-only customer segments
description: Shop owner sees customer counts, segments, campaigns and COD setting; segment previews count only consenting customers, never names; conflicting rules rejected.

title: Verify a shop campaign moves draft, submit, operator approval and send, with tracking of opens and orders
description: Shop campaign cannot send before approval; operator can reject for resubmission; sent count stays within budget; opens, conversions and revenue are tracked.

title: Verify a customer referral rewards both customers once after the first delivery, within the referral cap
description: Customer referral reward goes to both wallets once after delivery with a reason; codes are case-insensitive, unknown codes do not block sign-up; rewards stop at the cap.

title: Verify campaign rate limits, customer frequency caps, budget bounds and shop-scoped marketing APIs
description: Shop gets a 3rd submit refused, customers get at most 1 per shop and 3 per 7 days, out-of-range budgets and double sends fail, other shops get 403.

title: Verify referral abuse earns no reward and an admin can reverse a fraudulent reward without a negative wallet
description: Self or duplicate referrals give no reward and raise a risk flag; admin reversal writes a ledger entry and the customer wallet never goes below zero.

title: Verify the admin analytics page shows KPI cards and a daily GMV trend that matches delivered orders
description: Admin analytics KPI cards and GMV trend load, change with the date window, and GMV equals the value of the controlled delivered orders.

title: Verify fulfilment KPIs (fill rate, acceptance, pick-pack, assignment, delivery, on-time) match test orders
description: Admin sees order fill rate, shop acceptance and pick-pack time, rider assignment and delivery time and on-time rate matching the controlled orders.

title: Verify cancellation, refund, customer repeat, shop retention and subscription retention rates
description: Admin KPIs give cancelled/total, refunded value/GMV, repeat customers, retained active shops and retained vs cancelled subscriptions as the data shows.

title: Verify rider gig acceptance and utilisation and marketing campaign conversion KPIs
description: Admin sees gig acceptance (50% for the controlled pair), utilisation from online sessions, and orders attributable to campaign recipients in the window.

title: Verify an empty date window shows zeros not errors and shop analytics stays limited to the own shop
description: Admin KPIs show zeros or dashes (no NaN or Infinity) for an empty window; a shop owner sees only own-shop analytics, another shop or customer gets 403.

title: Verify test.gokesari.com blocks search engines in robots.txt and shows a branded 404 page
description: Guest sees robots.txt disallowing search engines on the test site (testing agent allowed) and a branded 404 with navigation instead of a stack trace.

title: Verify GoKesari redirects to HTTPS and sets session and gk_location cookies HttpOnly and Secure
description: Guest HTTP requests redirect to https; the customer session and gk_location cookies carry the HttpOnly and Secure flags.

title: Verify write APIs refuse unauthenticated calls and ignore server-assigned fields sent in a request
description: Every write API answers 401 to a guest; a customer cannot set server-assigned fields (status, prices, owner ids) from the request body.

title: Verify malformed ids and server errors return 404/422 or a generic error without stack traces or SQL
description: Customer requests with malformed ids get 404/422, not 500; error responses never expose stack traces, SQL or file paths.

title: Verify stored script text is shown escaped and no response leaks PAN, bank, OTP or secret values
description: Customer-entered script text is displayed escaped everywhere; no role ever receives full PAN, bank details, identity numbers, OTPs, codes or secrets.

title: Verify the GoKesari header gives every role working links and all legal and policy pages load
description: Header links for guest, customer, shop, rider, operator and admin open working pages with no dead links; every legal and policy page has content.

title: Verify the main customer pages work on a phone screen and the browser console stays free of errors
description: Customer pages have no sideways scroll, reachable menus and tappable buttons on a phone, and no uncaught errors or hydration warnings in the console.

title: Verify empty lists show helpful empty states and admin edit screens warn before unsaved changes are lost
description: Customer screens with no data show a helpful empty state, not a blank page; admin edit screens warn before leaving with unsaved changes.

title: Verify every plan case is declared in tests/qa, each check records its result and the register lists all
description: Every case ID is automated or declared manual; each check records ID, status, tier, site and spec; the register holds every case and scenario per site.

title: Verify writing and local QA tiers never run on gokesari.com and the weekly workflow runs only the guest tier
description: Signed-in and local checks are skipped on production with write helpers refusing it; the Monday workflow runs tests/qa/guest on both sites without writing.

title: Verify the Claude QA agent and skills are installed and the local QA environment seeds the plan test data
description: The QA agent and its run, sign-in, write-test and report skills are installed; the local environment migrates, seeds and lists every test account.

title: Verify a first visit on Android or iPhone shows the right install prompt and it fits the phone screen
description: Guest on Android sees the Get the GoKesari app sheet without a backdrop; iPhone Safari gets the three-step Add to Home Screen guide; sheet fits without scroll.

title: Verify Not now hides the install prompt only for that page view and declines are counted on the account
description: Guest decline closes the sheet but the prompt returns on visits 2 and 3; a signed-in customer has declines and installs saved, signed-out calls get 401.

title: Verify installing from Chrome removes the prompt for good and the installed or native app never shows it
description: After install via Chrome dialog gk_app_installed stops the sheet; standalone mode, the related app and the native Android/iPhone app show no prompt or update bar.

title: Verify the service worker uses a versioned cache and an installed web app picks up a new deploy
description: Guest gets sw.js with no-store and a gk-static-<version> cache; after a deploy the update bar reloads to the new version and old caches are deleted.

title: Verify the native update check lists latest and minimum versions and the app offers and installs a newer build
description: The update endpoint returns android/ios latest, minimum and https links; the native app offers Later/Update (Update only below minimum) and installs over the old build.

title: Verify shop owners download the product upload template as CSV and Excel with GST, loose and category lists
description: Shop owner gets GoKesari_Product_Upload_Template.csv with the template columns, and the Excel template offers GST slab, Loose Item (Y/N) and Category drop-downs.

title: Verify a shop downloads its own catalogue in the upload layout and no customer or guest can download it
description: Shop owner downloads the catalogue with SKU, HSN, GST %, MRP, price, stock and hidden product ID columns; customers get 403 and guests 401.

title: Verify tax invoices show cess correctly and a composition dealer issues a bill of supply with its GSTIN
description: Customer invoice totals add taxable, CGST/SGST or IGST and cess to the price paid, GSTR-1 shows csamt; a composition shop prints a bill of supply with GSTIN.

title: Verify product upload preview rejects price above MRP and non-slab GST and reports only the rows to fix
description: Shop owner upload preview rejects Selling > MRP and non-slab GST rows, warns on a loose item without weight unit, and the result CSV lists only rejected rows.

title: Verify after a failed delivery only operations can mark the order delivered and a return to shop is notified
description: Shop owner gets 409 marking a failed-delivery order delivered, operator/admin can; returned-to-shop notifies buyer and shop and is logged in order events.

title: Verify a customer purchase of packaged, loose and multi-line items charges exactly and moves stock to match
description: Customer wallet is debited once for goods plus delivery fee at the current price and MRP; loose goods priced to the paisa; stock movements link to the order.

title: Verify the sale shows in full on the customer purchase history and the shop order list
description: Customer history lists shop, lines, units, price, MRP and payment matching the wallet; shop order list shows the same lines without extra customer details.

title: Verify shop sales count delivered orders only and flow into the settlement at the price sold
description: Shop revenue rises only for delivered orders, not cancelled ones; admin settlement uses goods value at sale less commission, unaffected by later price changes.

title: Verify stock changes outside online orders: B2B purchase, in-shop sale and Excel stock upload
description: Shop stock falls for a B2B sale and an in-shop sale with movements and reasons; Excel stock upload applies valid rows and reports bad ones untouched.

title: Verify the shop inventory page shows on-hand, reserved and available with units, search, filter and sort
description: Shop inventory rows show product, unit, on-hand = available + reserved, low-stock threshold and price; loose goods take decimal kg/litre; search stays correct.

title: Verify stock received and written off are recorded as movements and the ledger adds up to stock on hand
description: Shop restock and damage/expiry write-offs create movements with before/after, reason, user and time; reductions below zero refused; ledger sum equals on-hand.

title: Verify reserved stock follows the order states and cancelled, rejected or failed orders return the stock
description: Shop stock is held for a placed order and released on delivery; cancelled, rejected and failed orders put the units back with a return movement.

title: Verify substitutions, removed lines and returned goods leave the stock of each product right
description: Shop substitution restores the original and reduces the substitute; a removed line is refunded and not resold; resaleable returns go back to stock, damaged do not.

title: Verify GoKesari never oversells: last-unit orders, stock below reserved and concurrent edits are guarded
description: Customer second order for sold-out stock fails OUT_OF_STOCK with no debit; shop cannot cut stock below reserved; stale edits are refused; storefront marks out of stock.

title: Verify shop inventory is private and inconsistent stock figures reach the admin dashboard
description: Other shops and customers get 403/401 on stock counts and movements; admin dashboard lists listings with negative or inconsistent availability with a matching count.

title: Verify a customer can create weekly shopping and monthly medicine lists with unique names
description: Customer creates a SHOPPING/WEEKLY list with reminder and a MEDICINE/MONTHLY list without; a second list with the same name in any case or spacing is refused (409).

title: Verify My lists is reachable from every entry point and the lists work on a phone screen
description: Customer reaches /lists from each menu and link; on a phone the lists, Check list bar, Confirm order and the Add to list sheet show without sideways scroll.

title: Verify a customer adds products to a list from the product card, including a new list and an existing line
description: Customer picks a list in the Add to which list? sheet or creates one with Create & add; a product already on the list keeps its quantity and note.

title: Verify list quantities (0-99), skip, notes up to 120 characters and removing a product
description: Customer sets quantities by stepper or typing, 0 marks Skipped this time, notes save on leaving the field; 100, -1, 1.5 and 121 characters give 422; removal persists.

title: Verify a customer can edit a list name, type, frequency and reminder, delete it, and get due reminders
description: Customer edits and deletes lists (duplicate names refused, deleted list 404); the daily job sends one Time to reorder notice per due date, none when reminder off.

title: Verify Check list prices the list like the cart and names lines that will be left out
description: Customer Confirm your order shows per-shop subtotal, delivery and total equal to the check API; out-of-stock lines are listed with the reason; cart-merge choice offered.

title: Verify Confirm order moves the list into an empty cart, adds it to a cart with items, or replaces the cart
description: Customer confirm puts only non-skipped lines in the cart with matching total, merges with or replaces existing cart lines, and marks the list Last ordered.

title: Verify the cart can be saved as a new purchase list or into an existing one
description: Customer saves the cart as a SHOPPING/WEEKLY list or into an existing list where cart quantities win and other lines stay; saving an empty cart gives 422.

title: Verify a list with nothing to order is refused and a list that cannot go in leaves the cart unchanged
description: Customer Check list is disabled when all quantities are 0 (API 422 Nothing to order); when no line fits, the cart stays exactly as it was with reasons shown.

title: Verify purchase lists are private: guests are sent to sign-in and other customers and hidden products give 404
description: Guest pages redirect to /signin and APIs answer 401; another customer list answers 404 not 403; unknown, inactive or unapproved-shop products cannot be added.

title: Verify tiered commission pays 20% direct, 4% lead and 3% main dealer at activation on each fee slab
description: Agent 20%, team lead 4% and main dealer 3% of the fee before GST (after coupons), all earned when the shop is activated, on the Rs 999, 4,999 and 9,999 slabs (DT-13 to DT-16, DT-23); STANDARD dealers keep their own rate; members are held until the agreement is accepted.

title: Verify renewal commission 10 / 2 / 1 %, the monthly target bonus, promotion and the development bonus
description: Renewals within 3 years pay 10% / 2% / 1% (DT-18); 50 activated shops in a month earn a bonus of 10% of that month’s commission for every role (DT-19); promotion to team lead at 50 shops and 3 ready agents, with the 1% development bonus for 6 months in months of 100+ team shops (DT-20).

title: Verify an approved shop gets its own SHOP referral code and /r/ link that opens Add my shop with the code
description: Shop owner sees a Refer another shop card with code, /r/CODE link and WhatsApp/Share/Copy; guest /r/SHOP... redirects to /shop/register?ref=CODE.

title: Verify a referred shop gets 10% off the fee and the referrer earns credit after the first delivered order
description: New shop owner can lock one code for 10% off the registration fee; referring shop gets Rs 200 promo credit (or a month) once, after approval and first delivery.

title: Verify one dealer payout per PAN per month with maker-checker approval and automatic bank transfer
description: Admin drafts one payout per PAN across roles; the drafter cannot approve; transfer marks PAID with UTR, failing banks are retried then flagged; manual pay works.

title: Verify dealer statement emails and payout reports download in CSV and XLSX with role-based access
description: Admin downloads summary, lines, pending and failed reports in CSV/XLSX and the statement email carries a CSV; guests are refused and operators cannot get the bank file.

title: Verify the admin TIERED and TDS-on-commission screens and the dealer team and TDS cards
description: Admin sees TIERED settings, team tree, requests, TDS rows, challans and 26Q/Form 16A; the dealer sees team earnings by type and PAN status, rate and TDS this year.

title: Verify the dealer tree stops at 3 levels and missing or self levels are never paid an override
description: Admin and the database refuse a 4th level; no lead override without a lead and no override on a dealer or lead own shop, so nobody is paid twice.

title: Verify TRADING commission lapses after the order window and a shop fee refund reverses every level
description: Admin sees part 2 and overrides as zero lapsed entries after the window; a refund reverses unpaid entries and books negative entries for paid ones into next payout.

title: Verify payouts are held without PAN, verified bank, agreement or CA-confirmed TDS, and show gross and net
description: Admin payouts are held or refused for missing PAN/bank/agreement or an UNCONFIRMED TDS row; only the CA confirms rates; TDS on shows gross, 2% TDS and net.

title: Verify shop referral guards reject same-owner or duplicate shops, cap rewards yearly and allow admin reversal
description: Admin sees referrals with same PAN/GSTIN/mobile/bank rejected, no reward past 20 a year, reversal never below zero; on production with rules off nothing changes.

title: Verify sign-in, sign-up and profile forms validate mobile, email, codes, terms consent and referral code
description: Guest and customer forms accept only valid 10-digit mobiles, emails and exact codes; sign-up needs T&C consent; unknown referral codes never block sign-up.

title: Verify the delivery-address form, location bar and search boxes validate PIN, phone, house and free text
description: Customer address needs name, valid mobile, house, city and a 6-digit PIN not starting with 0, one default and a consistent map pin; search input never gives 500.

title: Verify cart, checkout and wallet fields validate quantities, slots, payment method, codes and amounts
description: Customer cart quantities and loose weights, delivery window and slot, payment method, notes, coupon/voucher codes and wallet amounts are validated by page and API.

title: Verify the shop registration form validates names, phone, address, PIN, categories, PAN, Udyam and delivery
description: Customer registering a shop must give names, a valid phone and PIN, categories, at least one of Shop Act/PAN/Udyam in the right pattern and a valid delivery fee.

title: Verify shop settings validate GSTIN, FSSAI, KYC files, delivery radius, PIN zones, fees, hours and switches
description: Shop owner settings accept only a valid 15-character GSTIN, 14-digit FSSAI, safe files, 1-50 km radius, valid amounts and hours in IST; switches persist.

title: Verify shop listing fields validate prices, MRP, stock, thresholds, photos, new products and Excel upload
description: Shop owner listing prices and MRP need positive 2-decimal amounts, stock and thresholds whole in-range numbers; photos and Excel files are type and size checked.

title: Verify product master, admin MRP, shop categories and price references validate names, GTIN, HSN and GST
description: Operator and admin product master needs a name, listed category and unit, 8/12/13/14-digit GTIN, 4/6/8-digit HSN and a listed GST rate; price references are checked.

title: Verify order-handling fields for shop reasons, rider pickup and delivery codes, failed delivery and COD cash
description: Shop reject/remove/substitute need valid choices or reasons; rider pickup code and OTP must be exact; failed delivery needs a reason; ops override needs a proof note.

title: Verify the rider application validates name, mobile, vehicle, KYC document, bank account and IFSC
description: Customer applying as rider must give a name, valid mobile and vehicle type, a safe KYC file, a 9-18 digit account number and a correctly patterned IFSC.

title: Verify return, refund, issue, grievance, rating and contact-shop forms validate amounts, reasons and text
description: Customer return quantities, reasons and photos, shop/operator refund amounts, issue and grievance text, 1-5 star ratings and shop messages are validated.

title: Verify society registration, society rules and subscription fields validate PIN, mobiles, quantities and dates
description: Customer society sign-up needs name, address and PIN; society rules take optional text and valid rider mobiles; subscriptions check quantity steps and schedule dates.

title: Verify admin and operator forms validate business rules, commission, fees, vouchers, settlements, user edits
description: Admin and operator numeric rules, commission %, fee schedule, payments, vouchers, rider slots, adjustments, deposits, dates and reasons refuse invalid values with 422.

title: Verify marketing segment and campaign fields and the consent and notification preference switches
description: Shop segments need a valid rule and campaigns name, message, budget and future schedule; customer consent switches persist, security notices cannot be switched off.

title: Verify every GoKesari form marks required fields, supports keyboard use and the server repeats page checks
description: All roles see required marks and messages beside fields; tab order and phone keypads work; APIs refuse what pages refuse; odd numbers, emoji and long text never cause 500.

title: Verify the identity-first screen: referral code, GSTIN or PAN, declaration, consent and verify
description: The first registration screen takes the referral code and a GSTIN (or PAN without GST), validates formats and limits, and verifies with the government record before anything else (shop owner).

title: Verify each government-check outcome is explained and handled (verified, mismatch, not found, service down)
description: Sandbox.co.in results map to clear owner messages; an outage never fails the owner, unsupported documents go to manual review (shop owner, admin).

title: Verify the wizard collects owner, address, map pin and shop details in the owner's order before payment
description: Owner, address, map pin (before pay), shop details, turnover-slab fee and review steps with their validations (shop owner).

title: Verify paying the registration fee takes a verified shop live and guides the owner to add products
description: Sandbox fee payment, failed-payment retry, unpaid-shop messages, live and done screens, e-mail and the IST registration date (shop owner).

title: Verify duplicate shops are held or refused (same GSTIN / PAN, same name at same PIN, second unpaid shop)
description: Guards that stop duplicate or unpaid multiple registrations while letting legitimate shops go live (shop owner, admin).

title: Verify a missing mandatory licence gives 90 days' grace, reminders, then automatic suspension
description: Licence by shop type, grace notice e-mail, 15-day reminders, auto-suspension and its effect on the storefront (shop owner, admin, customer).

title: Verify an unfinished registration is reminded, reported to the dealer, and abandoned after 7 days
description: Reminder e-mails at 24 h and 72 h, dealer notice, cancellation on payment and the 7-day abandoned draft (shop owner, dealer).

title: Verify the guided 3-step product setup and that customers see only Live listings
description: Choose categories, add products, set stock and price; listing statuses and filters; storefront shows only Live listings (shop owner, customer).

title: Verify the product import template enforces mandatory columns and rejects bad rows, importing the rest
description: Template download, mandatory Name / Category / MRP / Stock, Selling > MRP, bad numbers, GST slabs, unknown category, error download (shop owner).

title: Verify 'Update many products with Excel' applies valid rows and explains every rejected row
description: Setup file columns, row errors (Product ID, Include, prices, category), file limits and duplicate-file guard (shop owner).

title: Verify the starter shelf and barcode scan let a new shop list products quickly
description: Starter shelf ranking, pre-ticked at MRP, publish validations; barcode found / unknown flows (shop owner, admin).

title: Verify the shop chooses how it delivers and its radius, and customers see it
description: Own staff / GoKesari partners / pickup only, radius 1-10 km, saved message and effect on serviceability (shop owner, customer).

title: Verify a delivery partner verifies Aadhaar through DigiLocker and every failure is explained
description: DigiLocker consent, mock on staging, masked Aadhaar, declined / expired / mismatch / vendor-down / already-used outcomes, admin resend (rider, admin).

title: Verify a bank account is checked with the bank (Secure ID) and every failure is explained
description: Add account, re-enter match, Secure ID verified / failed / provider error, 3 checks a day, UPI keeps the Rs 1 check (rider, shop owner).

title: Verify a delivery partner withdraws earnings within the Rs 100 - Rs 10,000 and daily limits
description: Withdrawal limits and messages, unpaid-earnings cap, daily limit, partners only, verified bank account required, flags off (rider).

title: Verify withdrawals and bank-account changes need the e-mailed code
description: E-mailed code on every withdrawal and to change a verified rider bank account (10-minute grant) (rider).
